summary: Session 74.10 frontend-only validation of the fully fluid Sticky-CTA + ProductMenu on https://finance-platform-v2.preview.emergentagent.com/. Verified CTA bounding boxes across 11 viewports (320→1920), mobile menu fluid width/height, desktop clamp widths, 2-col grid, unique testids, compact header, compact product rows, browser zoom 80/100/125/150/200 %, position safety at 320 px, ESC + outside-click, dismiss → restore-pill → restore, analytics events, all 6 wizards opening and the full aktien wizard flow incl. validation-UX up to the Success screen. 1 real defect found: at short landscape viewports (>=640 px wide, ~375 px high) the ProductMenu overshoots the TOP of the viewport by ~17 px, so the menu header (eyebrow/H3) is clipped — max-h min(72dvh,38rem) does not account for the CTA height + offsets.

ui_bugs.issue: Position safety violated at short landscape viewports: 812x375 and 667x375 → menu bounding box y = -17 (top clipped, eyebrow 'KURZFRAGEBOGEN' and part of H3 cut off). Natural menu height 262px is below max-h min(72dvh,38rem)=270px at h=375, but available space above the CTA is only ~239px (375 - 20 bottom - 108 CTA - 8 mb), so no clamping kicks in. 896x414 and 1366x600 are fine.

issues: Main CTA button is still fixed width w-[24rem] (measured 432x108 at 768→1920) and is NOT fluid via clamp(15.5rem,78vw,22rem) as stated in the request. Only the mobile CTA and the restore pill follow the clamp. Confirm this is intentional; on 768px width the 432px CTA is the widest element at bottom-right (no overflow, no h-scroll).

action_items: Fix menu top-clipping on short landscape viewports (e.g. max-h-[min(72dvh-8rem,38rem)] or max-h-[calc(100dvh-10rem)] for the desktop branch, so the menu never exceeds the space above the CTA).
Clarify/align desktop main-CTA width: request asks for clamp(15.5rem,78vw,22rem) but desktop uses fixed w-[24rem].
critical_code_review_comments: ProductInquiryStickyCta.jsx (612 lines) is close to the 700-line limit and now contains 3 render branches (dismissed / mobile / desktop) with duplicated wrapper class strings — consider extracting the sticky container into a shared subcomponent.

Only ONE ProductMenu definition remains and only one sticky root renders per viewport — the duplicate-definition issue from the previous session is resolved (verified: exactly 1 [data-testid=product-inquiry-sticky-cta] and exactly 6 unique menu-option testids on every viewport tested).
max-h protection should be derived from available space above the anchor, not from dvh alone.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview site shows a blocking [data-testid=visitor-welcome-gate] modal on every fresh load: select the first non-empty option in BOTH selects, then click 'Akzeptieren'. A second blocker is the #invtopic-teaser interstitial ('Aktien im Fokus') which hides the sticky CTA entirely — close it before any CTA test, especially when scrolling to the newsletter. Restore pill testid is product-inquiry-sticky-restore (NOT ...-compact). Menu widths/positions all match the 74.10 clamp spec; only the short-landscape top clipping (812x375 / 667x375) is open.
rca_of_the_issue: The desktop ProductMenu is anchored with 'absolute bottom-full mb-2' above a ~108px tall CTA that sits at bottom-5. Its height cap is max-h-[min(72dvh,38rem)], which ignores the space consumed by the CTA and its offsets. At viewport height 375 the cap resolves to 270px while only ~239px are available above the CTA, so the 262px menu renders with y=-17 and the header is clipped. Fix: subtract the anchor height, e.g. max-h-[min(calc(72dvh-8rem),38rem)] or max-h-[calc(100dvh-10rem)], keeping the internal grid scroll.
